changelog: After an AI rewrite, tapping the ↩ undo button — or saying "undo" — now restores your original dictated message instead of deleting the whole rewritten text. Undo always undoes the most recent step: if you dictated more after the rewrite, the first undo removes that new part and the next undo brings back the original. The "undo the rewrite" voice command still works too. If you typed or edited since the rewrite, it refuses instead of touching your text.
